structural_exclusions: per-path first and last access dates

protected_strata.description: Strata that may contain requests initiated by a person: user-initiated fetches, and unattributed, unverified or failed-verification clients whose stored label cannot exclude a browser.

grains.strata: non-protected strata in full detail; protected strata combined into one group per date x site x population (see daily_protected_group)
main documentary population, provider-origin tier, roles ai_training and ai_search only

forbidden_combinations: day x actor_role, stored tier, method or status for any protected stratum
day x family for any protected stratum
user_initiated_fetch in any daily series, figure or metric
differencing_argument: Every published table is a marginal of one of the three maximal grains above. A marginal can still isolate a cell when crossed with another marginal: if a daily stratum covers a single path at the edition grain, its daily series is path-level. Protected strata are therefore published per day only as one combined group per site and population, which spans at least minimum_paths paths (checked by verify), and user-initiated fetches appear in no daily output. Differences between published tables, filters or editions then yield, for protected strata, no combination finer than date x site x population. Non-protected automated strata keep their daily detail; see accepted_residual_cases.
accepted_residual_cases: The robots_control population contains a single path (/robots.txt); its daily counts, including the combined protected group, are therefore path-level. It is a public crawler-control file, outside the main population.

The undeclared_bucket population is one collector bucket per site (/.well-known/__undeclared__); its daily counts, including the combined protected group, are therefore bucket-level. The bucket is not a document and aggregates requests to many undeclared names.

A non-protected automated stratum (a named software agent whose stored tier is provider-origin or network-verified, in a role other than user_initiated_fetch) whose edition cells cover a single path makes its daily row path-level for that software agent. No protected stratum is involved.
A documentary family that contains a single path on all sites makes a cell of daily-family-summary.csv path-level for automated provider-origin crawlers only. No protected stratum is involved.

actor_names_at_edition_level.scope: Named software-agent families (for example GPTBot) are published as actor names at edition level only; day-level outputs never carry an actor name.

daily_protected_group.label: protected_strata
daily_protected_group.rule: In daily-summary.csv every request of a protected stratum (protected actor role or protected stored tier) is counted in a single row per date x site x population whose actor_role and stored_identity_tier are 'protected_strata' and whose http_method and http_status are 'ANY'. No daily view, figure or metric carries user-initiated fetches.
daily_protected_group.minimum_paths_rule: Outside single_path_populations, each combined group must span at least this many paths with protected requests at the edition grain; otherwise verify fails and the owner chooses a coarser grouping before any publication.

amendments.change: Protected strata combined in the daily grain; the failed-verification tier added to the protected strata, as its definition requires; user-initiated fetches removed from daily series (G01 and the main.daily metrics); undeclared bucket and non-protected single-path strata listed as accepted residual cases; differencing argument corrected.
amendments.reason: A crossing check on the candidate edition found three protected daily strata whose edition cells covered a single path, so the day of those requests to that path could be recovered by crossing daily-summary.csv with consultations.csv (one of them a single user-initiated fetch).
amendments.effect_on_results: No edition-level count changes; the main result, the role split and the scope delta are unchanged. Daily views now count automated roles only.
